fieldValues.title: A decision finalised in exactly one session is already how the clerk's records are kept
fieldValues.summary: All 156 ratified decisions in srs-programme were ratified in exactly one session and none in more than one; sessions that discuss without finalising use a considers relation; one ratified decision has no ratifying session.
evidence: srs-programme 2026-11-27: programme/ratifies 156, considers 6 (one decision considered in two sessions), sets-aside 1
1 ratified decision with no ratifies relation
fieldValues.body: The minutes package should take the session and its relations from the clerk, not model its own: a meeting is a session with a record of what was said, and its decision points consider decisions that live outside it.
